global_projector.description: In the finite-dimensional workstation representation, H is constructed as the sum of the 22 coordinate projection operators from the frozen Phase 1 registry. This yields the 22-dimensional identity projector and validates the global projector interface under controlled structural conditions.

admissible_space.description: Synthetic projected states must remain finite and within declared numerical norm bounds.

operator_composition.composition_note: These explicit pairs are a deterministic compatibility sample for Phase 3 workstation validation. Their evaluation must not be interpreted as a global commutativity claim.

non_claims: Phase 3 validates the declared global projector only.
Phase 3 does not introduce Level-1 dynamics.
Phase 3 does not assume global commutativity.
Phase 3 does not use empirical data.
Phase 3 does not constitute SWORD execution.
Phase 3 does not prove structural necessity.
